prompts.grinder-ode: Simplify this into a true flat small-interface silhouette. Preserve the recognizable outer form, object proportions, pose, and principal part arrangement exactly. Use only solid pure black and pure white. Eliminate every gray plane, texture, highlight, hairline seam, tiny notch, tiny island, and sliver. All retained white channels must be deliberately broad—at least 20 pixels in this 1254-pixel image. Join any parts separated only by a hairline. Keep the background pure white and generous blank margin. Do not add text, logos, decorative elements, or new features. Retain only the large dial ring, broad hopper/body separation, and clear cup-to-chute opening; remove rear top triangle seam and all side-plane seams.
